csv_project_name: Engineering for SS4A Comprehensive Safety Action Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Alliance, Nebraska has been awarded funding through the U.S. Department of Transportation Safe Streets and Roads for All (SS4A) program to prepare a Comprehensive Safety Action Plan. The City is requesting statements of qualifications from consulting firms with experience in transportation safety planning, crash analysis, public engagement, and development of Safety Action Plans consistent with USDOT SS4A requirements. The selected consultant will assist the City in developing a Safety Action Plan that identifies transportation safety challenges, engages community stakeholders, and establishes prioritized strategies and projects to reduce fatalities and serious injuries on Alliance's transportation network.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
